dedupe_keys.name: pvgis photovoltaic geographical information system jrc solar radiation and pv performance tools with api

description: PVGIS, run by the European Commission Joint Research Centre, gives information on solar radiation and photovoltaic system performance for any location in the world except the North and South Poles. The interactive tools estimate the output of grid-connected, tracking and off-grid PV systems and return monthly, daily and hourly radiation and a typical meteorological year, which the JRC offers as standardised input for building energy calculations. The JRC page lists free and open access with no registration, maps of solar resource and PV potential by country or region, geospatial data download and interfaces in English, French, Italian, Spanish and German. All tools are available through a web API with entry points for PVGIS 5.3 and 5.2 (tools PVcalc, SHScalc, MRcalc, DRcalc, seriescalc, tmy and printhorizon), GET requests only and a limit of 30 calls per second per IP address; outputs can be taken as CSV or JSON. The current production version is 5.3, and a PVGIS 6 beta with a Python backend published on the Commission code platform extends the solar data from 2014 to 2024. Coverage is global. Caveats: results are modelled from satellite and reanalysis irradiance, AJAX calls are not allowed, and usage conditions sit on a separate page. Simulation uses are hourly PV generation and irradiance series for renewable capacity planning, rooftop potential and weather-driven supply scenarios.
